note: After Holmgren's (1912) original description of the new species (in German), there placed in the genus Calotermes (Calotermes marianus nov. spec.) and later transferred to Incisitermes; only the alate is described, the soldier and worker are missing in the original, and the specimens are dry-preserved. In the OCR 'lÖgliedrig' is 16-segmented and has been corrected from the context.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (Dry specimen.) Pale chestnut brown, the underside rusty brown, the wings grey. Head and pronotum with a few long setae. Head elongate-oval, rather thick. Compound eyes rather large and flat. Ocelli rather small, almost touching the compound eyes. Antennal sockets distinctly depressed. Frons slightly flattened. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 2 and slightly longer than segment 4. Pronotum wider than the head, with a fine marginal rim, the anterior margin concave and almost semicircular, the posterior margin nearly straight; the anterior margin of the fore wing scale distinctly arcuate. Subcosta well developed, reaching one third of the wing; radius extending slightly farther; radial sector with 6—7 rather long anterior branches, the first arising almost at the first third of the wing; about 5 cross-connections between the media and the radial sector; the area between the media and the cubitus strongly reticulate; cubitus with 10—12 branches.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm): body length including the wings 15.00; body length without the wings 8.00; fore wing 12.00 long, 3.40 wide; head length 2.17; head width 1.71; pronotum width 1.94. Locality: Mariana Islands. The original describes the alate only (dry specimen); the author states that, because the specimen is dry, the colour notes are not fully reliable.
